name: AI in Education and Research: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free hour built around seven real jobs in schools, campuses, labs and training teams: leveling a reading passage, drafting rubric feedback, handling an AI-detector flag, screening abstracts, writing and reviewing an NIH application, vetting a classroom AI tool, and turning an SOP into a microlearning module. Each shows where AI helps, where it must not decide, and the rule that applies.

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 7 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
